title: stepscroll blocks
description: Every block a page of the world can hold, keyed by the block's name. A page is 256 pixels across and 256 lines down. A block is its entries: tiles from tiles.json, each at a byte column and a bottom line, drawn exactly as they are. Sky and rock between and under them come from the tiles themselves: down each column, below a tile, whatever its bottom row shows. See world.py.

entries.description: What the display list draws in this page, in order.

column.description: The byte column of its left byte in the page, 0 to 31.

bottom.description: Its bottom line in the page: odd, as the blitters go up a row pair at a time.
